1.description: Average income earners with moderate spending behavior. Stable, predictable, and representative of the mass middle market.
1.marketing_strategy: Seasonal discounts, family packages, standard loyalty tier progression, cross-category recommendations, and customer satisfaction surveys.
1.retention_priority: Medium-High - Volume anchor of overall business.

2.description: Modest income earners who spend conservatively. Highly price-sensitive, practical, and focused on essential utilities.
2.marketing_strategy: Value-oriented promotions, clearance events, bulk buy discounts, reward points on essentials, and transparent pricing without hidden fees.
2.retention_priority: Low-to-Medium - Focus on automated cost-effective retention.

3.description: High income earners with high spending scores. Highly lucrative, brand-conscious, and value exclusivity.
3.marketing_strategy: Direct high-tier loyalty programs, early access to luxury product launches, VIP events, personalized concierge, and premium bundled services.

4.description: High income earners with conservative spending habits. Prudent, analytical, and seek tangible quality or ROI.
4.marketing_strategy: Emphasize product quality, durability, premium warranties, and financial rewards/cashback. Targeted premium marketing highlighting long-term value.
